record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare WAVE_SPLASH: Piplup (1 star), Prinplup (2 stars), Empoleon (3 stars); all have range 1 and maxPP 100 per the unit blocks. The strategy is shared; the only per-unit difference is the star count (table index) and, through maxHP, the unit's own HP. The percentage table is the same for all three listed units. Units that merely evolve into or from these are not covered unless listed.
record.summary: The caster first gives itself a shield and then deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target; both requested amounts are round(caster maxHP x 0.2) for 1-3 stars (0.5 for 4 stars or as the fallback), so for these units the requested shield and the requested damage are equal. The shield is applied before the damage. The in-source comment says '[20,SP]%' but the code only uses the 0.2/0.5 table; the AP factor enters later, in addShield and in handleSpecialDamage.

targeting.who: shield: the caster itself; damage: the cast target (the unit the caster is attacking when the cast fires)
targeting.note: The caster must reach its target (requiresTarget true). There is no area, line or secondary target. Which unit is chosen as the cast target is decided by the generic targeting code, which was not read.

declaredRaw.label: fraction of the caster's maxHP (requested amount = Math.round(maxHP x fraction))

effects.scaling: requested = round(maxHP x fraction) with the caster's maxHP at the moment of the cast (the current maxHP, not the base stat in the unit block). applied: PokemonEntity.addShield first applies Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, for a holder); PokemonState.addShield with apBoost 1 then multiplies by (1 + AP/100), by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT), by 0.5 if the caster is enraged, and rounds.
effects.resolution: requested (rounded fraction of maxHP) -> after Big Eater Belt -> applied (after AP, crit, enraged halving, rounding) -> added to the caster's shield, only if the caster's hp > 0; the shield stat is max(0, shield + value). No timer in this file; later damage taken by the caster consumes the shield first in handleDamage.

declaredRaw.label: fraction of the caster's maxHP (requested amount = Math.round(maxHP x fraction))

effects.scaling: requested = round(maxHP x fraction), the same figure as the requested shield, computed from the same maxHP (the shield call does not change maxHP, so the two values are equal). handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) because apBoost defaults to true; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit; also the DOUBLE_DAMAGE and steam-board multipliers recorded for AQUA_TAIL apply since it is the same function. Big Eater Belt does not touch damage.
effects.resolution: applied (the figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage) = requested after those multipliers. handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first. takenDamage reported = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp); it is 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (blocked entirely, magic bounce may reflect). The requested, applied and takenDamage amounts are three different numbers.

shields: self shield = round(maxHP x 0.2) requested (raw), applied after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit and enraged halving

starBehavior.note: The table is indexed by the casting entity's stars: 1-3 stars give 0.2, only 4 stars (and the ?? fallback) give 0.5, which is not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. The listed units differ in the result only through their own maxHP (base hp 60 / 130 / 240 in the unit blocks, before any later modification). Whether other mechanics raise a star count or change maxHP was not examined.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0), adds a new shield on top of any existing one (shields stack by addition) and deals its damage again. Because the amounts are fractions of the current maxHP, a later change to maxHP changes the next cast.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: shield and damage are each round(maxHP x 0.2) at 1-3 stars (a fraction, not a flat table). Applied shield = requested after Big Eater Belt, AP, crit, enraged halving and rounding. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then reduced by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1; takenDamage includes shield damage. The comment's '[20,SP]%' is not a separate scaling in the code. Final values additionally depend on untraced item and field effects.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located

Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (e.g. Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, resurrection, passives, weather and field multipliers) was only partly read: protect, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1 and shield absorption were read; later death handling was not
Whether the 500 ms magicBounce reflection or Power Lens retaliation matters: they were read in handleSpecialDamage but not simulated
unresolved: Order of the two effects within a cast is shield first, then damage: if the damage kills the target or triggers an on-death effect, effects keyed to that were not traced
Whether the caster's shield is still applied when the damage is blocked: it is (addShield is not conditioned on the damage result and runs first)
How maxHP of these units changes during a fight or through items/synergies (the requested amounts follow the current maxHP) was not traced
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
